title: Pick the right journal entry in one tap

lines.say: Let's record a journal entry with a free practice card from the Edlintics glossary.
lines.caption: Let's record a journal entry with a free practice card from the Edlintics glossary

actions.text: Journal entry is the first record

lines.say: A business buys four thousand five hundred euros of office supplies on credit, and it uses them straight away.
lines.caption: A business buys €4,500 of office supplies on credit, and it uses them straight away

lines.say: Every transaction touches at least two accounts, and total debits equal total credits.
lines.caption: Every transaction touches at least two accounts, and total debits equal total credits

lines.say: The supplies are used up at once, so office supplies expense goes up with a debit.
lines.caption: The supplies are used up at once, so office supplies expense goes up with a debit

lines.say: The business has not paid yet, so it owes the supplier, and accounts payable goes up with a credit.
lines.caption: The business has not paid yet, so it owes the supplier, and accounts payable goes up with a credit

lines.say: That is answer B, with four thousand five hundred on each side, so the entry balances.
lines.caption: That is answer B, with €4,500 on each side, so the entry balances
